question: On what surfaces may the seat-mantra be ritually placed?
premises: Birch bark is an allowed surface.
A banyan leaf is an allowed surface.
The seat-mantra is to be placed there.
inference: The practitioner may place the seat-mantra on birch bark or on a banyan leaf.
plain_english: One should place the seat-mantra there on birch bark or on a banyan leaf.
